ip.label: Plug IP address
ip.description: Local IPv4 address of the Xiaomi smart plug, for example 192.168.1.100.

token.label: Device token
token.description: 32-character miIO token for the plug. Stored in Noctalia plugin settings.

poll_seconds.label: Refresh interval
poll_seconds.description: How often to query live power, from 3 to 60 seconds. Right-click the bar widget to refresh immediately.

python_path.label: Python interpreter
python_path.description: Optional. Leave empty to use uv when available, otherwise python3. Set this to force a local Python that has python-miio installed.

siid.label: Power SIID
siid.description: MIoT service id for live power. Xiaomi Smart Plug 3 (cuco.plug.v3) uses 11.

piid.label: Power PIID
piid.description: MIoT property id for live power. Xiaomi Smart Plug 3 (cuco.plug.v3) uses 2.

status.unconfigured: Set the plug IP and token in plugin settings

errors.missing_python: Python was not found. Install Python 3, or set the interpreter in plugin settings.
errors.missing_uv: uv was not found on PATH.
errors.missing_runtime: Neither uv nor Python was found. Install uv (recommended) or Python 3 with python-miio.
errors.missing_script: The bundled poll helper is missing from the plugin directory.
errors.missing_miio: python-miio is not installed for the selected interpreter.
errors.invalid_ip: The plug IP address is invalid.
errors.invalid_token: The device token must be 32 hexadecimal characters.
errors.invalid_response: The plug helper returned an invalid response.
errors.request_rejected: The plug query could not be started.
errors.device: The plug rejected the power query.
